append.detail: ── PROBE RE-POINTED 2026-10-14 (overhaul, PR #3434). The /search people query moved verbatim out of app/(main)/search/page.tsx into app/(main)/search/search-data.ts (searchPeople, shared by the DAWN page and the Frequency search body), and isListableInDirectory moved with it. The probe now reads the module the query lives in; page.tsx imports searchPeople from it. ── 2026-10-15 shared search: the overlay API now delegates to canonical searchPeople. The fast probe follows that import and call, executes the real provider against competing hidden/Ghost/inactive/public rows before a one-result window, verifies no hidden truncation leak, and retains the other listing seams plus target-radius/connections migration assertions. Full provider privacy regressions remain in CI.
